input.quote: MarketSite.net Access Fee: Due upon Software Acceptance, and on each annual anniversary of Software Acceptance thereafter.
input.rationale: Exhibit B commits Corio (our party) to a flat annual MarketSite.net Access Fee (Year 1 and Years 2-5 and beyond, p0153) payable on each anniversary across a five-year initial term (p0096) that can only be exited for material breach or insolvency (p0097) — a de facto multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right, which is our walk-away position. In addition, the revenue share in p0158 is measured against a deemed "minimum limitation of 40 Authorized Software Users per Customer" rather than actual usage, creating a minimum charge untethered from consumption. Our preferred position is fees for usage or ordered services only; the minimal fallback edit adds a 30 days' notice discontinuation right with a pro-rata true-up instead of any penalty or shortfall charge, and ties the revenue share to actual Authorized Software Users. Commitments Commerce One makes to us (e.g., its MarketSite transaction revenue share in p0156) are unaffected.

proposal.summary: Add a 30-day reduction/discontinuation right with true-up for the annual MarketSite.net Access Fee and remove the deemed 40-user minimum in the revenue share calculation.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept multi-year take-or-pay: the annual MarketSite.net Access Fee runs for the full five-year term with no reduction or exit right, and the revenue share is calculated on a deemed minimum of 40 users per Customer rather than actual usage. We have added a 30 days' notice discontinuation right with a pro-rata true-up (no penalty or shortfall charge) and tied the revenue share to actual Authorized Software Users.

ops.oldText: MarketSite.net Access Fee: Due upon Software Acceptance, and on each annual anniversary of Software Acceptance thereafter.
ops.newText: MarketSite.net Access Fee: Due upon Software Acceptance, and on each annual anniversary of Software Acceptance thereafter; provided that Corio may discontinue its access to the MarketSite.net Service upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Commerce One, in which case no further annual MarketSite.net Access Fee shall accrue and the parties shall true-up amounts due for access actually provided through the effective date of discontinuation, without penalty, shortfall or termination charge.

ops.oldText: subject to a minimum limitation of 40 Authorized Software Users per Customer
ops.newText: calculated on the actual number of Authorized Software Users per Customer
